analysis.rationale: R0 pipeline survives R1 reanalysis unchanged. (1) JPEG confirmed in 5/5 pairs by 0%-FP block_boundary 1.3257-1.7437; severity 1 beats severity 2 on canonical fingerprints across both audited pairs (pair0 dct 0.561 vs 0.613, sigma 2.22 vs 1.85; pair3 dct 0.7976 vs 0.8301, spatial_corr 0.3592 vs 0.4032) and on verify_signals (jpeg:2 sigma regressions 27%/67%), jpeg:2 only wins block_boundary. (2) Noise is multiplicative: target RIC 0.24-0.57 (positive in 5/5 pairs) matches speckle:2 sims 0.23-0.55; poisson:2 sim RIC 0.232/mean_shift -2.78/variance_ratio 0.931 misses target 0.476/-6.93/0.843; additive gaussian/YCrCb sims have RIC ~0 and peeled rgb_ratio 1.03-1.08 excludes YCrCb; impulse excluded by impulse_zero_ratio 0.075-0.166. (3) Speckle severity 2 is the best compromise: sev3 fixes clipping-derived stats but breaks block/noise-spectrum signals (sigma +29%, bb -11%, dct -12%); sev1 is too weak on pair0 (sigma 40%). (4) Blur absent: spectral_slope_ratio 0.9696-0.9954 in 5/5 pairs; adding blur:1 drives noise sigma 80% off. (5) Global absent: every x_distortion global function has a coarser minimum step than observed (brightness shift +-25.5 levels, darken gamma 1.4, contrast_weaken scale 0.75 -> variance ratio 0.56, saturation x2.0/x0.7); observed mean_shift -0.85..-9.07 and variance_ratio 0.811-0.987 track per-pair clipped_fraction 0.0021-0.0543 (speckle multiplicative clipping), not a uniform global step. UNCERTAIN per protocol: noise step can never be LIKELY under sigma>=2.
